# SA — state-admission role profile r0.5

Exact role: admission of one owner-authorized resolved weighting/state
generation for an admitted parent class. It records Learn candidate, Resolve,
subspace/rank/null, regularization, support/missingness, numerical profile,
failure semantics, and 'optimality_status'. SA depends on PA and selected
AO-001/AO-002 dispositions; it never selects a fallback.
